title: FCC主席：指控华特迪士尼公司回应不，重审广播牌照能否通过？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In recent interviews you've also been asked of course about Disney and you've said that you've not made a decision on whether to pull Disney's broadcast licenses
segments.zh: 在近期的采访中，你被问及迪士尼，你说尚未决定是否吊销其广播执照，涉及多元与包容政策。

segments.en: over various diversity and inclusion practices. Again, remind us of the FCC's remit in that area, but what it would take for you to look at a potential action.
segments.zh: 请再次说明FCC在此领域的职权，以及什么情况会促使你考虑采取行动。

segments.en: Yeah, with respect to Disney in particular, the FCC has three proceedings that are going on or sort of three buckets of issues. One, starting all the way back in March
segments.zh: 关于迪士尼，FCC目前有三项程序或三大类问题。第一，从2025年3月开始，

segments.en: of 2025, I wrote a letter to Disney leadership raising concerns about some of their practices, including what we call in videos forms of DEI discrimination, whether there's potential
segments.zh: 我致信迪士尼领导层，对其做法表示担忧，包括视频形式的DEI歧视，以及是否存在

segments.en: evidence indicating that they may have been discriminating with effective pay or compensation or workplace opportunities based on race, gender or protected characteristics. There's
segments.zh: 基于种族、性别或受保护特征的薪酬或职场机会歧视的证据。

segments.en: a role for the FCC there. We have particular rules on EEO policies and discrimination.
segments.zh: FCC在此有职责，我们有关于EEO政策和歧视的具体规定。

segments.en: So we've been looking into that for quite a while. In fact, we've been doing some letters of inquiry, our versions of subpoena. And frankly, the view was that Disney was being disingenuous
segments.zh: 我们调查已久，发出了调查函。坦率说，迪士尼对FCC调查的回应不够坦诚。

segments.en: in the way it was responding to the FCC's inquiries. And so we took the next step in our enforcement abilities, which was called in all of Disney's broadcast licenses for early renewal. So Disney
segments.zh: 因此我们采取了下一步执法措施，要求迪士尼所有广播执照提前续期。迪士尼已提交申请，

segments.en: has now applied. And they have to demonstrate that they've been operating in the public interests.
segments.zh: 必须证明其运营符合公共利益。
